# antd_client (vendored)

Dart client for the antd daemon, from
`https://github.com/WithAutonomi/ant-sdk` (folder `antd-dart`, commit
`81010e9fc1dc0b36fca813de01a8ff13ca9427d1`, version 0.4.0) — the revision
pubspec.lock had resolved. Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, LICENSE-MIT,
LICENSE-APACHE).

It is kept here because the GitHub repository answered 404 on 2026-11-12 and
`flutter pub get` could not fetch it. Only `lib/`, `pubspec.yaml` and the
license/readme files are copied; the code is unchanged. When the upstream
repository is available again it can go back to a git dependency in the
launcher's pubspec.yaml.
